description: This file defines the InstanceCreationHelper class within the OrangeHRM installer utility namespace. It includes static constants for countries, languages, and time zones, as well as methods for retrieving time zones and details about specific countries and languages.

classes.name: InstanceCreationHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static data and methods for initializing instances with country, language, and timezone information in the OrangeHRM installer module.

methods.name: getTimezones
methods.description: Returns a list of all available timezone identifiers formatted as an array of objects with 'id' and 'label'.

methods.name: getCountryByCode
methods.description: Retrieves details of a country based on its country code.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Retrieves details of a language based on its language code.
